name: Tapita SEO Optimizer
summary: All-in-one Shopify SEO app: site audits with LLMs.txt for AI search engines, bulk and AI-written metadata, image alt text and compression, JSON-LD schema, broken-link auto-redirects and one-click speed fixes.
best_for: Shopify merchants on the Basic or Grow plan who want SEO audits, bulk metadata, image alt text and speed fixes out of one app instead of hiring a specialist
skip_if: you are on Shopify Advanced or Plus, where the same tier costs $30 to $60 a month more, or you need a published per-credit rate before you build a month of AI metadata around it
honest_knock:
The price on the listing is a Shopify-Basic price, and almost nobody reads the line underneath it. The same Pro plan is $39.99 on Shopify Basic, $44.99 on Grow, $69.99 on Advanced and $99.99 on Shopify Plus, because Tapita adds $5, $30 or $60 on top depending on your Shopify plan. That is a two-and-a-half-fold spread on identical software, and it is the single largest factor in what this app costs you. Work out which row you are on before you compare it to anything else.

The second meter has no published rate at all. Basic gives you 100 AI metadata credits a month and Pro gives you 500, and beyond that the listing says only that more audit pages and more credits carry an extra charge. It does not say how much, and it does not say how many credits one product's metadata consumes. Tapita's own sister app publishes $0.06 a credit on its listing; this one publishes nothing, so you cannot price a month of AI metadata before you install.

And the free tier is a demonstration rather than a plan: 50 products for bulk alt text and file names, 30 images a day, and the SEO audit and LLMs.txt limited to basic pages. Any real catalogue is on a paid tier within a week, which is fine as long as you know that going in.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-21 on apps.shopify.com/google-seo-schema-meta-data) Three tiers. Free: SEO audit and LLMs.txt on basic pages, unlimited on-page SEO audit, essential JSON-LD schemas, and image compression 900 a month capped at 30 a day. Also bulk and AI metadata optimisation, bulk image alt text and file names for 50 products, one-click page speed and 24/7 support chat. Basic $9.99 a month or $101.88 a year, a 15% saving, adds SEO audit and LLMs.txt on main pages, auto image optimisation 100 a day, 100 AI metadata credits a month, full JSON-LD schemas, broken-link detection with auto-redirects and advanced speed features. Pro $39.99 a month or $408 a year adds all main pages, 500 images a day, 500 AI credits a month, higher speed capacity, full automation of image alt text and file names, unlimited keyword research and hands-on help fixing SEO and Search Console issues. Both paid tiers carry the same surcharge line, and it is the number that decides what this costs: +$5 on the Shopify Grow plan, +$30 on Advanced and +$60 on Shopify Plus. So Basic is $9.99, $14.99, $39.99 or $69.99, and Pro is $39.99, $44.99, $69.99 or $99.99, depending on which Shopify plan you are on. Extra audit pages and extra AI credits are billed on top and the listing does not print a per-credit rate. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Developer Tapita, M5 Building, 91 Nguyen Chi Thanh, Hanoi; the app launched 15 March 2023 and carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge.
